description: A dataset of inter-county distances along the real-world highway and railway networks in the contiguous United States is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Yongxin Cai, Xinyan Li. This dataset provides transportation mode-specific inter-county shortest-path distances along the real-world highway and railway networks in the contiguous United States . Coverage: global (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3503379764 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
